_comment: TrackCluster — Link G4X XtremeX CAN broadcast config. Apply in PCLink → CAN → Custom Setup. This JSON is the single source of truth; the firmware link_g4x.json must decode every channel listed here.
name: Link G4X XtremeX — TrackCluster Dashboard

channels.name: MAP Absolute
channels.note: Use MAP (ABSOLUTE), not MGP. ~100 at idle, never negative. Firmware subtracts 100 kPa for gauge boost.

channels.name: ECT
channels.note: +50 PCLink offset; firmware subtracts 50 then converts to °F.

channels.name: Oil Pressure
channels.note: 2 bytes (u16). Firmware kPa → PSI. Widened from 1 byte (capped 37 PSI).

channels.name: Fuel Pressure
channels.note: 2 bytes (u16). Firmware kPa → PSI. Widened from 1 byte (capped 37 PSI).

channels.name: Lambda 1
channels.note: Decode: raw / 1000.0 = lambda. Do NOT add Lambda 2 / baro.

channels.name: Fuel Level
channels.note: Wire tank sender to an AnVolt input; calibrate 0-100% in PCLink before assigning.

streams.name: Engine Protection Status
streams._comment: Engine-protection/limit flags ONLY. Each byte: 0=OK, nonzero=active. Firmware ORs each nonzero byte into one warning bit and shows the RIGHT-cluster full-screen warning (up to 3, highest priority first: knock > ign-cut > fuel-cut > boost-cut > sensor > throttle). Do NOT put gauge-shown conditions here (oil pressure, fuel level, coolant/oil/IAT temps) — those are already shown by gauge color. Map each byte to a Link limit/protection flag (Link broadcasts limit flags as a bit field; route the relevant bit/level to each byte, or send the limit % directly).

channels.name: Knock
channels.note: Nonzero = knock detected / knock retard active.

streams.name: Drive Assist & Status
streams._comment: NEW — ECU->RealDash stream (Section E of CAN-BUS-ID-ALLOCATION-TABLE.md). Custom/BigEndian, ECU-broadcast. Bytes 3 (TC setting) & 5 (boost map) are ECU ECHOES: the ECU receives the cluster 0x3ED/0x3EC selections and re-broadcasts them here, so RealDash never reads cluster frames directly. PCLink: receive 0x3EC/0x3ED into channels, place them in bytes 5/3.

channels.name: TC Setting (ECU echo)
channels.note: ECU echoes the cluster 0x3ED TC selection.

channels.name: Boost Map Index (ECU echo)
channels.note: ECU echoes the cluster 0x3EC boost-map selection.

streams.name: Extended Sensors
streams._comment: NEW — RealDash-only (Section E). Custom/BigEndian, all ECU-sourced. Temp bytes use +50 PCLink offset (ECT/IAT convention; firmware/RealDash subtract 50). Coolant Pressure is 2 bytes (u16); Cabin Temp was dropped to make room and is no longer available via the ST185 RealDash inputs.

channels.name: Coolant Pressure
channels.note: 2 bytes (u16) for headroom. Cabin Temp dropped from this frame to make room; cabin temp is no longer sent to RealDash.

streams.name: IMU & Extended Warnings
streams._comment: NEW — RealDash-only (Section E). Custom/BigEndian. Accel X/Y/Z are SIGNED int16 (scale 10 → raw/10 = g). Byte6 bitmask; byte7 reserved 0x00. Requires PCLink to expose g-force channels and a packed warning bitmask (math/virtual channels).

channels.name: Extended Warnings Bitmask
channels.note: bit0=Flat Shift,bit1=Radiator Fan,bit2=Low Fuel,bit3=High Coolant Press,bit4=Low Oil Press(2nd),bit5=Switchboard Comm Fault(ECU-set),bits6-7=spare

dashboard_to_ecu._comment: The center ESP32-P4 TRANSMITS these frames to the ECU (TWAI_MODE_NORMAL). ECU must be configured to receive on these IDs.

frames.purpose: Boost map selection (1 byte: map index 0-3)
TC slip-angle selection (1 byte: angle index 0-4)
